78659.subject: Weekly Recap: Tokenized Stocks Mania
78659.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

Robinhood Chain collected more in fees this week than any other blockchain, and the tokenized stocks it was built to carry spent the week coming apart from the companies they reference.

The fee line moved first. Users paid $4.45 million in gas on Tuesday, 82 times the network's total eleven days earlier and more than **Ethereum**, **Solana** and **Tron** combined. **Pons** took $4.89 million in launchpad fees on Monday against **pump.fun**'s $1.72 million, crypto trading terminals cleared their first billion-dollar day since January 2025 with 91% of **GMGN**'s trades settling on the chain, and **Uniswap Labs** bought PONS four weeks after opening a competing launchpad. Robinhood absorbs the gas inside its own wallet app through Sept. 29.

The wrappers went next. A memecoin called BONER held 53% of the tokenized **Hims & Hers** float over the weekend and printed the stock token at $132.64 against a $28.84 share. On Wednesday a memecoin named after a mushroom variety in **Farmmi**'s own annual report ran the Nasdaq company's shares up as much as 321%, trading against a FAMI “stock token” Robinhood never issued. Thursday evening **AMC** chief executive **Adam Aron** told Robinhood to halt trading in its AMC token, and Robinhood's chief legal officer told him to send his lawyers.

The institutional version of the same trade kept moving. Twenty-one banks and asset managers, among them **Wells Fargo**, **Fidelity** and **Capital One**, said they will incorporate a joint dollar-stablecoin issuer this year. The **SEC** proposed transfer agent rules that name blockchain recordkeeping. **Nomura**'s Laser Digital will set risk parameters for institutional lending markets on **Euler**, and **Coinbase** filed notice registrations toward single-stock perpetuals in the US.

Elsewhere, **Cronos** validators restarted their chain from a block four seconds before the Tectonic exploit, discarding 10,961 blocks and one hour and 54 minutes of everyone's transactions. **Fogo** has produced no block since Aug. 29.

Enjoy!

## Tokenized Stocks and Memecoins: Revolutionary Primitive or Retail Wipeout?

Youtube: 🟢 LIVE : Tokenized Stocks and Memecoins: Revolutionary Primitive or Retail Wipeout? (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tOGWujoAa6A)

Camila Russo hosted Glider co-founder Brian Huang and Ethlabs founding member Binji Pande on Friday, hours after AMC's chief executive demanded that Robinhood stop trading a token referencing his company's shares. Huang argued that the venue matters more than the wrapper, and that AMMs guarantee no best execution the way US brokers do. Pande called the price gaps a supply problem, and a six-dollar tokenized AMC print “bad market structure.” **[Watch the full conversation.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tOGWujoAa6A)**
